Title: Some users' Microsoft Intune enrolled Windows devices may experience device check-in delays of up to eight hours

User impact: Users' Microsoft Intune enrolled Windows devices may experience device check-in delays of up to eight hours.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Intune and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users' Microsoft Intune enrolled Windows devices may experience device check-in delays of up to eight hours

User impact: Users' Microsoft Intune enrolled Windows devices may experience device check-in delays of up to eight hours.

More info: While we're working to remediate impact, affected users can perform a manual check-in. 

Current status: This event is a continuation of the issue previously communicated via IT1547988. 

Our monitoring has identified an increase in delays affecting check-ins for Microsoft Intune-enrolled Windows devices. Our investigation indicates that an issue in a recent Windows update is causing initial device check-in attempts to fail, while subsequent automated and manual attempts remain unaffected. We're continuing to analyze the changes introduced in the recent Windows update to isolate the specific root cause and determine an appropriate remediation strategy.

Scope of impact: Any user with a Microsoft Intune enrolled Windows device may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:00 PM UTC
